digest.digest: President Trump has stated that the war effort in Iran is funded through January, indicating a potential limited window for new military operations before the new Congress convenes. This funding timeline suggests that legislative changes could impact future military options. Discussions within the Trump administration have included the possibility of targeted killings of senior Iranian leaders as a strategy to conclude the conflict, though opponents caution this could harden Tehran's stance and hinder diplomatic efforts. Concurrently, concerns are rising globally about the underpricing of risks associated with further conflict in Iran. The economic repercussions of the war are becoming increasingly apparent, with significant impacts on corporate profits and consumer costs. EasyJet's annual net profit has seen a substantial decline, attributed to soaring fuel prices exacerbated by the ongoing conflict. British household energy bills are also projected to increase significantly due to the war. These economic pressures, coupled with potential political constraints on military action, highlight a complex and evolving situation surrounding the Iran war.

next_events.title: US Military Action Window Closes in January
next_events.description: President Trump has indicated that current war funding for operations related to Iran expires by the end of January. This creates a potential limited window for significant military action before a new Democratic Congress, which may seek to constrain presidential military options, takes office. Analysts should monitor any accelerated military planning or rhetoric leading up to this deadline.

next_events.title: Potential for Targeted Strikes on Iranian Leadership
next_events.description: Reports indicate the Trump administration is actively debating the possibility of targeted killings of senior Iranian leaders. This highly escalatory measure could be seen as an attempt to swiftly end the conflict but risks hardening Tehran's stance and undermining future diplomatic efforts. Watch for any intelligence leaks or official statements regarding such operations, and the international community's reaction.

next_events.title: New Congress to Reshape US Iran Policy
next_events.description: With a new Democratic Congress approaching, President Trump has acknowledged that his military options regarding Iran could be limited. The incoming legislative body may push for a more diplomatic approach or seek to restrict executive authority on military engagements. Watch for early legislative initiatives, committee hearings, and statements from key congressional leaders that signal a shift in US Iran policy and potential constraints on military action.

next_events.title: Escalating Global Economic Disruptions
next_events.description: The ongoing conflict is already impacting global markets, causing delays in IPOs, significant profit drops for airlines, and rising energy costs for households. Analysts should continue to monitor key economic indicators, commodity prices (especially oil), and corporate earnings reports for further signs of widespread economic disruption and potential recessionary pressures stemming from the conflict.
